نتمخلب (form IIq)
# نَتَمَخْلَبُ (natamaḵlabu) /na.ta.max.la.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَخْلَبَ (tamaḵlaba)
# نَتَمَخْلَبَ (natamaḵlaba) /na.ta.max.la.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَخْلَبَ (tamaḵlaba)
# نَتَمَخْلَبْ (natamaḵlab) /na.ta.max.lab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَخْلَبَ (tamaḵlaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
